sentences.japanese: お客が雑な作りのスタンドに座って靴を磨いてもらっている。
sentences.english: A customer is having his shoes shined on a slapped-together stand.
He is careless and untidy in his work.

sentences.japanese: 彼、一気呵成に書き上げたと言ってたけど、この提案書、少し雑だね。
sentences.english: He said he dashed this proposal off in one sitting. It's pretty sloppy.

sentences.japanese: お前は物を雑に扱い過ぎる。もっと丁寧にやれよ。
sentences.english: You do things too sloppily. Please do things more carefully.
